name: What is the difference between natural gas and propane fire pits?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between natural gas and propane fire pits?

acceptedAnswer.text: Natural gas fire pits connect directly to your home's existing gas line, providing an unlimited fuel supply without needing refills. This is generally more cost-effective if you have natural gas service. Propane fire pits use portable tanks, offering flexibility in placement but requiring tank refills or exchanges. Natural gas typically burns cleaner and provides a slightly softer flame, while propane can achieve a more robust flame with proper burner design. The decision often comes down to convenience, existing utility access, and desired portability.
acceptedAnswer.description: Natural gas fire pits connect to your home's line for unlimited fuel, while propane uses portable tanks requiring refills. Natural gas is often more cost-effective and cleaner, but propane offers flexibility.
